create.name: Rev. Dr. Stephanie Red Feather
create.bio:
Stephanie Red Feather is an American shamanic minister, author and teacher who works mainly with empaths and other highly sensitive people. Her early life mixed the performing arts with hard science: she studied applied mathematics and geophysics and served as an officer in the US Air Force before turning to spiritual work. Since 2005 she has been a mesa carrier in Peru's Pachakuti Mesa Tradition, trained with Oscar Miro-Quesada and with Linda Star Wolf, whose Shamanic Breathwork she facilitates, and later completed a master's and a doctorate in shamanic studies at Venus Rising University. She is also trained in Reiki and in Voice Dialogue.

Through Blue Star Temple, the online home for her teaching that she founded and directs, she offers one-to-one spiritual coaching, shamanic astrology and oracle readings, house clearings, and weddings and other ceremonies as an ordained minister. Her themes include energetic boundaries and clearing, balancing masculine and feminine, shadow work and living with a sensitive nervous system in a busy world. She wrote The Evolutionary Empath and created the Empath Activation Cards oracle deck, painting its artwork herself, and she has contributed chapters to several shared anthologies on shamanism and spirit animals. She also runs self-paced video courses and hosts an annual online empath summit.

books.title: The Evolutionary Empath: A Practical Guide for Heart-Centered Consciousness
books.author: Stephanie Red Feather
books.description: Her main book, a guide for sensitive people to understanding how they take in energy, setting boundaries and seeing their sensitivity as part of a wider shift in consciousness.

books.title: Empath Activation Cards: Discover Your Cosmic Purpose
books.author: Stephanie Red Feather
books.description: A 44-card oracle deck with guidebook, illustrated with her own paintings, meant for reflection on purpose and inner guidance.

courses.title: Spiritual Coaching Packages
courses.description: Packages of three, six or twelve private sessions that draw on ceremony, shamanic journeying, Voice Dialogue, oracle cards and shamanic astrology, shaped around whatever the client brings.

courses.title: The Art & Practice of Energetic Clearing
courses.description: A self-paced video course in eleven modules on clearing your own energy, rooms, homes and sacred objects with tools such as sage, feathers, crystals and rattles. An option with a private session is also offered.

courses.title: Weddings, Ceremonies and House Clearings
courses.description: As an ordained minister she leads weddings, hand-fastings and rites of passage in many traditions, and she offers ceremony planning and in-person or distance clearings of homes, offices and land.

free_resources.title: Free Stuff from Blue Star Temple
free_resources.description: Short free teaching videos on her site, including how to use a pendulum and a mesa invocation from her Andean tradition, plus a free starter manual for sensitive people.
